summary: Temporary Access Passes last longer, central admins can be managed on managed tenants, and failures are easier to spot.

new.title: Longer Temporary Access Pass
new.text: When no lifetime is set, a Temporary Access Pass now lasts up to 48 hours, never longer than your tenant allows. A new one is issued until the admin registers their own sign-in method.
new.action: To allow the full 48 hours, raise the maximum in Entra ID > Authentication methods > Temporary Access Pass.

new.title: Central admins on managed tenants
new.text: Reset Temporary Access Pass, Revoke sessions and Access now work for a central admin replicated to a managed tenant.

new.title: Create an admin from Create access
new.text: The Create access page has a card that opens the same wizard as + New admin.

fixes.title: Failures are easy to see
fixes.text: Engine logs & errors shows a red count of failed runs and lists them first. Jobs lists failing jobs first.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Admin mail on managed tenants reaches the alert recipients, department owners show at once on Admin accounts, and rejected policy changes show more detail.
